### A Heart Full of Gratitude Instead of Grumbling
Author: Emily Rose Massey
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/a-heart-full-of-gratitude-instead-of-grumbling-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Philippians 2:14-15
Points:
- Grumbling and complaining stem from sin and fail to honor God regardless of difficult circumstances.
- Complaining ultimately questions God's goodness and sovereign control over daily life.
- Believers can counter dissatisfaction by intentionally cultivating gratitude and rejoicing in Christ's mercies.
- Disagreements with others must be handled with humility rather than pride or unnecessary conflict.
- Shunning grumbling and clinging to God's Word allows believers to shine as distinct lights in a dark culture.

### How Do I Know God’s Will?
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/how-do-i-know-gods-will
Passage: Philippians 2:12-13
Points:
- Discerning God's direction begins by studying the clear commands and guiding principles of Scripture.
- Believers are called to actively obey and do their part with a reverent spirit.
- God works within His people to align their desires and actions with His good purposes.
- Circumspection and a sensitive conscience help believers recognize God's leading through open and closed doors.
- Seeking counsel from wise, trusted mentors provides clarity in understanding God's plan.
